description_zh: 调用该接口更新时间模板
name: UpdateTimeTemplate

fields.help_en: The start time of each day. Valid values: 0 to 86399. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 每天开始的时间，取值范围0~86399，单位为秒
fields.name: begin

fields.help_en: The day of the week. Valid values: 0 to 6, which represent Sunday through Saturday
fields.help_zh: 每周的周几，取值范围0~6，表示周日~周六
fields.name: day_of_week

fields.help_en: The end time of each day. Valid values: 1 to 86399. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 每天结束的时间，取值范围1~86399，单位为秒
fields.name: end

parameters.help_en: The ID of the time template. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107890.html to query the ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the time template.

The name must be fewer than 48 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:)
parameters.help_zh:
时间模板名称。

名称长度小于48个字符，可以包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符：短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）、英文冒号（:）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable 24/7 recording. Valid values:

1: Yes.
0: No. For detailed configurations, see the TimeSections.N.DayOfWeek, TimeSections.N.Begin, and TimeSections.N.End parameters
parameters.help_zh:
是否7天*24小时录像：

1：是。
0：否，详细配置请查看TimeSections.N.DayOfWeek、TimeSections.N.Begin和TimeSections.N.End参数
parameters.name: all_day

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: success.
Other values: error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
